name: Saffron Kiln Orchards
core_rationale: Sun-warmed southeastern glaze-terrace orchards of Continent 01 where Sola's golden ceramic aqueducts irrigate saffron-apricot groves and honey-glaze vats.
local_conflict: Nectar-sipping glaze beetles and warm-clay orchard sprites raid the saffron drying racks.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bakers in Lantern Hollow say a single drop of honey-glaze from Saffron Kiln Orchards keeps hearth-loaves warm for seven days.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped golden-brick orchard terraces crowned by teapot-shaped honey presses and apricot blossoms.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What subterranean nectar-kiln bubbles beneath the central press of Saffron Kiln Orchards?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the southeastern aqueduct terraces of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stepped golden-brick orchard terraces irrigated by warm ceramic aqueducts and teapot honey presses.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m orchard terrace roads, 0.58m honey-press counters, and 0.14m brick risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Apricot Aqueduct Terrace and Saffron Press Village.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-apricot-aqueduct-terrace as a Mystery frontier.
